_meta.title: Correlation register

tiers.A: Empirical — computed from official NBA.com team data, with n and a p-value.
tiers.B: Structural — true by construction, not an edge.
tiers.C: Not computed — data required is unavailable; value left null and NOT guessed.

_meta.method_note: p-values use the normal approximation to the t distribution. With n=30 this is close to exact but is disclosed rather than implied.
_meta.multiple_comparisons_note: 10 pairs were tested. At alpha=0.05 you expect about 0.6 false positives by chance alone. Treat any single marginal result with suspicion; the site reports the count of significant pairs but does not treat them as independently confirmed.

tier_b_structural.note: True by definition (NBA.com glossary: 100*(PTS-OPP PTS)/POSS reduces to the difference of the two ratings).
Scoring identity; enforced as a data check on every player row in verify_data.py.

An earlier version of this register listed 'plus_minus vs net_rtg' as an empirical correlation. It came out at r=0.999, which is the tell: it is an identity, not a finding. It has been moved here rather than presented as an edge.
SPREAD = home points - away points, so a negative spread means the home team is favoured.

tier_c_not_computable.pair: Player points OVER + same player rebounds OVER
tier_c_not_computable.why_missing: Needs a player game-log corpus (per-game values for many games) to measure co-movement. NBA.com exposes per-game logs one player at a time; the volume needed (thousands of rows) could not be retrieved in this environment.
tier_c_not_computable.how_to_obtain: Pull https://www.nba.com/stats/players/boxscores for every player-season, or use the official NBA stats API game logs.

tier_c_not_computable.pair: Player points OVER + same-game team total OVER
tier_c_not_computable.why_missing: Needs the joint distribution of a player's stat and the game total. Requires game logs joined to final scores.
tier_c_not_computable.how_to_obtain: Join per-game player box scores to final scores from https://www.nba.com/games.

tier_c_not_computable.why_missing: Needs teammate game logs and controls for total team possessions.
tier_c_not_computable.how_to_obtain: Same corpus as above, grouped by team-game.

tier_c_not_computable.pair: Team spread cover + team total OVER
tier_c_not_computable.expected_sign: positive (a fast game helps the favourite's total)
tier_c_not_computable.why_missing: Needs historical closing lines to define 'cover'. No official line source is reachable here.
tier_c_not_computable.how_to_obtain: Requires a licensed odds archive. This is the single largest blocker in the project.

tier_c_not_computable.pair: Player points OVER + opponent's defensive rating quartile
tier_c_not_computable.why_missing: Needs per-game player performances against specific opponents.
tier_c_not_computable.how_to_obtain: NBA.com player splits by opponent, aggregated across a full season.

tier_c_not_computable.why_missing: Independence is an assumption, not a measurement. Two games on the same slate can share weather/travel/referee crews, so the assumption itself is unverified.
tier_c_not_computable.how_to_obtain: Test residual correlation of same-slate, cross-game legs against a historical results corpus.
